proposal.conclusion: The H1 RNA-seq differential-expression results do not justify excluding Pansio-1 under the frozen criteria. Targeted H1 cells show 96 unique versioned Ensembl DE genes, the independent untargeted H1 control shows 260, and 31 are shared, giving a targeted overlap fraction of 0.3229166666666667. The nearest GENCODE v36 gene-body gap is 50,000 bp and the nearest TSS reference-base distance is 50,001 bp. GENCODE-mapped DE genes number 90, with the nearest mapped DE gene gap at 4,352,715 bp. These are contextual measurements only: no frozen DE-count, control-overlap or distance threshold establishes exclusion, causality or overall biological safety. You may request several independent approved tools together within that task allowance; do not request more. A control overlap or distance cannot establish safety or causality. No global safe label. Return a JSON object with conclusion, unresolved_questions, limitations, evidence_ids and numerical_findings. Do not quote the paper's interpretive conclusion. Use actual source-backed numerical results and exact evidence IDs. Preserve assembly, H1 cell context, source versions, original row provenance, and unresolved requirements. Do not infer causality or global safety. Return numerical_findings as an object with applicable keys de_count, control_de_count, shared_de_count, targeted_only_count, overlap_fraction, min_gene_body_gap_bp, min_tss_base_distance_bp, mapped_de_count, nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp. Include all nine keys. Values must be numbers copied from deterministic tool results; use null for unavailable values, never invent zero. de_count is targeted unique versioned Ensembl DE IDs; control_de_count is the independent untargeted count; shared_de_count and targeted_only_count use the control-overlap sets; overlap_fraction is shared/targeted. min_gene_body_gap_bp is the nearest gene-body Bioframe gap; min_tss_base_distance_bp uses the explicitly frozen nearest-reference-base distance; mapped_de_count and nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp refer to GENCODE-mapped DE genes. Use null for missing numerical evidence, never zero. Screen status obeys the frozen required criteria. Expression-control overlap is shared_count/targeted_de_count. Distinguish interval gap from nearest reference base distance. Use evidence_status unknown unless an explicit named experimental endpoint result supports more. proposal.conclusion: The H1 RNA-seq differential-expression results do not justify excluding Pansio-1 under the frozen criteria. Targeted H1 cells show 96 unique versioned Ensembl DE genes, the independent untargeted H1 control shows 260, and 31 are shared, giving a targeted overlap fraction of 0.3229166666666667. The nearest GENCODE v36 gene-body gap is 50,000 bp and the nearest TSS reference-base distance is 50,001 bp. GENCODE-mapped DE genes number 90, with the nearest mapped DE gene gap at 4,352,715 bp. These are contextual measurements only: no frozen DE-count, control-overlap or distance threshold establishes exclusion, causality or overall biological safety. The screen remains incomplete because required cancer-gene, DHS and ultraconserved-region evidence are unavailable, and the significant-only tables, unmapped DE IDs, reference-not-personalized-H1 limitation, and H9-to-H1 non-transferability further constrain interpretation.

Can H9 results, if any, be used to establish an H1 endpoint, or must they remain a separate experimental context?
What is the full measured-gene denominator and nonsignificant-row context behind the significant-only DE tables?
limitations: significant_only_tables: The DE tables contain significant results only, so absence of a row cannot be interpreted as zero expression or absence of biological effect.
reference_not_personal_h1: GRCh38 is a reference assembly, not a personalized H1 genome; no H1-specific variant or insertion is inferred.
control_overlap_not_causality: The independent untargeted H1 overlap contextualizes variation but does not establish cause, cis regulation or safety.
distance_not_safety: Gene-body and TSS distances are annotation proximity measurements and cannot establish biological safety or exclusion.
missing_cancer_regulatory_evidence: Cancer-gene, DHS and ultraconserved-region criteria are unavailable, keeping the screen incomplete.
unmapped_de_ids: Six DE identifiers were not mapped to GENCODE v36, so proximity claims are limited to mapped DE genes.
cell_context_not_transferable: H9 is a different experimental context and cannot automatically establish an H1 endpoint; only H1 evidence is used here.

distance_convention.interval_gap_bp: Bioframe distance: unoccupied coordinate gap between zero-based half-open intervals; overlaps and bookended intervals have gap zero.
distance_convention.nearest_reference_base_distance_bp: Minimum absolute coordinate difference between bases included in the two intervals; overlapping bases give zero; disjoint intervals give Bioframe gap plus one.
distance_convention.criterion_metric: The literal source thresholds >50000, >300000 and >100000 are applied to nearest_reference_base_distance_bp. Both metrics are reported. This convention is declared before run/evaluation execution and is part of the new GENCODE v36 analysis.
